dct_description_sm:
An on-line interactive map of Manitoba showing the locations of recycling depots.  
  
  An interactive web application illustrating the locations of recycling depots established through the province’s extended producer responsibility (EPR) program. Pop ups for each location provide additional information, including the name of the facility, address, hours of operation and phone number. Manitoba Sustainable and Green Initiatives branch collects data from the 12 producer responsibility organizations (PRO) on an annual basis. This application is populated by the web map Find Your Eco-Depot.
